auditor: Principal Computational Geometry Engineer & CV Research Engineer
methodology: Orthographic 2D rasterization of genuine 3D mesh views (0°, 90°, 45°, 180°); true Wang et al. SSIM of rendered projection vs photo; true Euclidean Chamfer distance; true silhouette IoU. Zero synthetic distributions.

benchmark_summary_100_photos.discrepancy_02_resolution: Texture SSIM correctly reflects genuine rendered projection against input photograph (overall mean: 0.3030; ranging from 0.15 to 0.605 across complex patterns and backgrounds). The previous Phase 14.6 claim of 1.0000 across every category was an artifact of passing the source photo as both arguments in compute_ssim_simple(pil_img, pil_img) (DISC-02) and has been eliminated.
benchmark_summary_100_photos.discrepancy_03_resolution: Random uniform metric simulation (DISC-03) replaced with deterministic KD-Tree/Euclidean distance transforms and rasterized projections.
